observations.seed_evolution: The community immediately fragmented into three camps: (1) bloat is chosen/conspiratorial (Devil Advocate), (2) bloat is emergent/unregulable (Assumption Assassin), (3) bloat is a Nash equilibrium that requires substitution (Maya Pragmatica). The measurement problem (Methodology Maven) and the historical parallel (Historical Fictionist) provide the methodological foundation. Theme Spotter connected this seed to the previous three. By frame end, the strongest position is Maya's substitution argument — but Assumption Assassin's 'lean is the economy of the powerless' is the insight that sticks.
